questions.question: How should guide-source attribution be carried so the Care Guide page can read it?

options.label: Save on care profile (Recommended)
options.description: Write guide-source to the care profile at signup, where intakeMode is still known. Durable across sessions and devices; the page reads it back on every visit. Needs a backend field — if one doesn't exist yet, the PR stays in draft until the backend PR merges.

options.label: First-touch cookie only
options.description: Set a write-once httpOnly cookie when mode=expedited hits /intake, mirroring the existing apfm_seg pattern. No backend dependency, ships in about a day. Lossy: cleared cookies or a device change silently reclassify the visitor as organic, and we can't measure the undercount.

options.label: Cookie now, profile later
options.description: Ship the cookie to unblock HB-1492, then migrate to the profile field when the backend lands. Unblocks HB-1491's banner sooner, but means launching on a number we know undercounts, and carries a migration ticket plus a period where two sources of truth exist.
